{{Quote|Don't play naive with me! I've seen you&mdash;I've been watching you. You and your little network of spies. You're a feisty one. But no matter. It's too late for you.|Snaeb Fronk, to Tehlan Aleece|<ref name="Extracting Aleece">{{WizCite|book=Galaxy of Intrigue|story=Extracting Aleece}}</ref>}}
'''Snaeb Fronk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Fronk came to suspect that [[Tehlan Aleece]], the niece of the Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Venram Krax]], was secretly an agent of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], and after he was assigned to escort Aleece to a party on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], he revealed to her his suspicions. However, a group of agents sent by the Alliance to extract Aleece prevented Fronk from informing his superiors of Aleece's betrayal of the Empire.
